03

Enterprise-Grade Security & Compliance

Each Agent runs in a sandbox container, in a separate VPC from the main system, connected via private endpoints - inherently blocking unauthorized access. A sidecar network proxy independently manages traffic for each user, with complete resource and data isolation across tenants. Strict plugin security review intercepts malicious code before listing.

Sandbox ContainerVPC IsolationMulti-tenant IsolationPlugin Security Review

Human-AI Approval Loop

When AI attempts high-risk operations, an approval workflow is triggered. AI can autonomously complete safe operations, but high-risk actions - like deleting data or sending emails - require human confirmation, ensuring decision authority always stays with humans.

REAL WORLD SCENARIOS

Creating Value in Real Scenarios

3-Person Marketing Team, 30-Person Output

Competitor research, industry reports, social media copy, event planning - AI assistants collaborate throughout, with a 3-person team outperforming a 30-person department.

Legal Assistant for Contract Negotiations

Upload a contract and the legal expert Agent instantly analyzes risk clauses, identifies unequal obligations, flags hidden traps, and provides professional revision suggestions.

Weekly Reports: 4 Hours Down to 10 Minutes

Data extraction, comparative analysis, chart generation, and layout export - fully automated. Every Friday, the report is ready before you leave the office.

Cross-Border Trade in 10 Languages Seamlessly

The trade assistant understands business context - not just translation, but drafting emails that match local business customs, making your global business more professional.

Compound Returns on Organizational Knowledge

Every business decision, problem solved, and customer interaction makes expert Agents smarter. After a year, you've accumulated the collective wisdom of hundreds of people - who never take leave, never quit, never hoard knowledge.

New Hires Are Senior on Day One

It used to take 6 months to train a competent project manager. Now on day one, the assistant connects new hires to project management experts, knowledge bases, and case libraries. Training compressed from 6 months to 1 week.

3 People Scaling into 10 Countries

A 3-person overseas team with AI orchestrating regulatory research, compliance content, marketplace integrations, and order tracking. Not just translating text - running an entire go-to-market playbook.

20 Years of After-Sales Knowledge, Preserved

After the veteran engineer retires, all expertise lives in the after-sales specialist Agent: symptom → diagnostic path → solution → parts dispatch. New staff get senior-level guidance with one question.
